create.name: Duncan Rice
create.bio:
Duncan Rice is a hatha yoga teacher in Durban and the principal teacher of Yogam Yoga, a registered charity that runs donation-based classes across the city and up the coast to Umhlanga and Ballito. Yoga came to him first through his father, who taught it in Kolkata, and he later spent years in India himself, training at Kaivalyadhama in Lonavala, at Parmarth Niketan in Rishikesh, where he learned the Kriya Yoga meditation methods of Paramahansa Yogananda, and with Bharath Shetty in Mysuru. He traces his lineage to Swami Sivananda of Rishikesh.

His classes keep a traditional shape: postures, breath work, mudras and bandhas leading into meditation, framed by Patanjali's eight limbs. He is especially fond of pranayama and sitting practice, and the timetable grades classes from gentle to strong so that newcomers and older students can take part. Seva, or selfless service, sits at the centre of the school: classes run on donations, members help with food parcels and after-school tuition in poorer communities, and the year-long teacher training charges only for its materials. He also leads weekend retreats at the Buddhist Retreat Centre in Ixopo, and some of his Musgrave classes are streamed live.

courses.title: Traditional Hatha Yoga: Hatha and Raja Yoga Weekend Retreat
courses.description: A residential weekend at the Buddhist Retreat Centre near Ixopo, open to beginners as well as regular practitioners. Days move through cleansing practices, postures, breath control, mudras and bandhas, then into guided sitting meditation in the hall and walking in the labyrinth.

courses.title: One-Year Traditional Hatha Yoga Teacher Training
courses.description: A teacher training spread over a full year of Saturday mornings in Durban, covering yoga philosophy and lifestyle, the main schools of yoga, postures, pranayama, mudras, bandhas, cleansing techniques and anatomy. Tuition is given free and the fee covers the course material; trainees are asked to attend regular classes and to give time back to the school as service.

courses.title: Weekly Hatha Yoga Classes by Donation
courses.description: Group hatha classes held through the week at venues in Musgrave, Glenwood, Durban North, Umhlanga, Ballito, Chatsworth, Queensburgh and Mount Edgecombe. Each class is marked mild, medium or strong so students can choose their level, and the Musgrave sessions are also streamed live.

The teacher training page still describes the Feb-Dec 2026 run (already started), while its image names a 2027 course; listed undated as a course that repeats each year. Check before ingest.
